events.verdict: Turner (IND) absorbs the contact with Antetokounmpo (MIL) before the pass.
Haliburton (IND) brushes Portis's (MIL) shoulder during his shot attempt near the rim and the contact is marginal.

Replay review of the foul called on Lillard (MIL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. During the drive, Nembhard (IND) overtly hooks his off-arm around Lillard's (MIL) arm and initiates the illegal contact between the two players.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) extends his arms slightly as he releases from Siakam (IND) and the contact is marginal.
Portis (MIL) is retracting his arm into a vertical position when he absorbs the contact with Mathurin (IND) during his driving shot attempt.
Siakam (IND) grazes Middleton's (MIL) side but the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Nembhard (IND) commits a take foul on Antetokounmpo (MIL).
Replay review of the foul called on Lillard (MIL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Lillard (MIL) holds Mathurin's (IND) arm, affecting his ability to pursue the loose ball.

Replay review of the foul called on Mathurin (IND) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Nembhard (IND) reaches in and initiates contact with Middleton's (MIL) arm that causes him to lose control of the ball.
